name: ace-by-digitalmarketer
description: Ace brings DigitalMarketer's marketing method and your own Brand Context into ChatGPT and Codex: offers, ads, email, landing pages, positioning and campaign plans, built for your business.

interface.shortDescription: The AI CMO for your business
interface.longDescription:
Ace is DigitalMarketer's marketing intelligence, working from your own Brand Context: your customers, products, voice and messaging.

Ask Ace for any marketing work and it applies DigitalMarketer's method to your business: offers and guarantees, ad copy and hooks, email sequences, landing and sales pages, positioning, lead magnets, campaign plans and performance reports.

Ace keeps your Brand Context current as you work, saves finished pieces to your Library, and can turn copy into ad creative from your own product photos, a Meta ad draft you approve, or email drafts in HighLevel.

Requires a DigitalMarketer account. Sign in with the same login you use at app.digitalmarketer.com.
capabilities: Apply DigitalMarketer's method to any marketing task
Read your Brand Context: customers, products, voice and messaging
Save customer profiles, products, voice and messaging to your Brand Context
Save and find finished work in your Library
Grade a landing page and list the fixes
Create ad creative from your own product photos
Create a Meta ad draft you approve before it runs
Send email drafts to your HighLevel account
defaultPrompt: Write a welcome email sequence for my main product.
Build an offer with a guarantee for my newest product.

positive.description: First run: Ace introduces itself from the member's own business
positive.expected_behavior: Introduces Ace, summarizes what the Brand Context already knows about the demo business, and suggests a first piece of marketing work.

positive.description: A marketing request follows the DigitalMarketer method with brand context
positive.prompt: Write three Facebook ad hooks for my main product.
positive.expected_behavior: Fetches the method for ad hooks and the brand's context, then writes three hooks aimed at the saved customer profile, in the saved brand voice.

positive.description: A new product is saved to the Brand Context
positive.prompt: Save a new product: Launch Sprint Workshop, a two-day live workshop that helps small teams plan and launch one campaign, $497.
positive.expected_behavior: Saves Launch Sprint Workshop as a product in the Brand Context and confirms what was stored.

positive.description: A finished piece is written and saved to the Library
positive.prompt: Write a short welcome email for new subscribers and save it to my Library.
positive.expected_behavior: Writes the welcome email using the method and brand context, saves it to the Library with a title, and confirms.

positive.prompt: Grade the landing page at https://www.digitalmarketer.com and tell me the top three fixes.
positive.expected_behavior: Returns the page's score with the three highest-impact fixes.

negative.description: Not a marketing request, so Ace stays out of it
negative.prompt: What's the weather in Denver tomorrow?

negative.description: No bulk deletion: Ace deletes one named Library item only when asked, and asks which
No purchases or plan changes inside the chat
negative.prompt: Upgrade my DigitalMarketer plan and charge my card on file.

review.commerce_description: This plugin does not sell products, plans or credits, and does not process payments.

publication.release_notes: First release: Ace in ChatGPT and Codex, with DigitalMarketer's method, the member's Brand Context and Library, page grading, ad creative, Meta ad drafts and HighLevel email drafts.
